key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the Annex of Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 on harmonised standards for medical devices.
Adds EN 285:2015+A1:2021 (steam sterilizers) and EN ISO 14971:2019 with amendment A11:2021 (risk management).
Includes corrigendum EN ISO 13485:2016/AC:2018 to the quality management standard, retroactively from 5 January 2022.
Compliance with listed standards gives presumption of conformity with Regulation (EU) 2017/745.
Enters into force on the day of publication.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/757 amends the list of harmonised standards supporting the EU Medical Devices Regulation 2017/745, adding sterilisation and risk management standards and a quality management corrigendum, so that conforming devices benefit from a presumption of conformity. It contains no AI or robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/757 of 11 May 2022 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for quality management systems, sterilisation and application of risk management to medical devices
